This provides a detailed understanding of how moderating variables influence the relationships studied, significantly improving the interpretation of the results. It allows for the identification of specific conditions or groups where the effects are more pronounced. Transparency and methodological rigor in presenting these variables are essential for other researchers to assess the robustness of the analysis. Furthermore, the discussion on moderating variables can shed light on unexplored areas and guide future research.
